meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先问你卡在四类工具调用症状中的哪一类，再按对应分支带你诊断并修 schema；它不替你写代码，而是指路到参考文件和 starter。
howto.when: 当你构建 tool-calling agent 卡住时——比如 LLM 不调用 tool、参数传错、ReAct loop 跑不停等——或要新设计 function schema 时接管。framework、MCP、监控问题会被转走。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不调用我写的 tool，帮我看 description 哪里有问题
tool 被调用了但参数不对，帮我修 parameters schema
我从零写一个 tool，带我按 5 步法设计 schema
say.note: 进入 (d) 分支，走 5 步 schema 设计

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first asks which of four symptoms you're hitting, then walks you through the matching diagnosis and schema fix. It points you to reference files and starters instead of writing the code for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're stuck building a tool-calling agent: the LLM won't call your tool, arguments are wrong, or a ReAct loop won't stop. Framework, MCP and monitoring questions get routed away.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool — help me fix the description
say_en.note: Enters branch (a), compares bad vs good schema

say_en.text: The tool is called but the arguments are wrong
say_en.note: Enters branch (b), checks type, required, enum

say_en.text: I'm designing a tool from scratch — walk me through the schema
